description: This file defines a SwiftUI View called ContextMenuCardView that displays a context usage card in the menu bar, showing session information and loading states.

classes.name: ContextMenuCardView
classes.description: A SwiftUI View that displays a context menu card with session details, status, and loading states.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the ContextMenuCardView with session rows, optional status text, and loading state.

methods.name: body
methods.description: Defines the main view layout for the context menu card, including conditional display based on session data and loading state.

methods.name: subtitle
methods.description: Computed property that generates the subtitle text based on the number of sessions.

methods.name: sessionRow
methods.description: Creates a view representing a single session row, including usage bars and tokens info.

methods.name: placeholderRow
methods.description: Creates a placeholder view used during loading states, simulating session data.
